fusions.name: Ramming Run
fusions.desc: Rams the target from up to 5 tiles, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full range, and knocks it 3.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Shoves a wave in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Full Sail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Gathering Way
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
